column1: FOODNUTR 0011A - INTRO TO F&N: HEALTHY EATING
column2: Course Description: An introductory course about the basic aspects of Healthy Eating. Emphasis will be placed on how students can use credible resources to find information about the nutrient content of foods, read food labels, nutrition recommendations (including Canada's Food Guide) and the eating habits for their life stage and make healthy food choices for themselves.Antirequisite(s): Grade 12U Nutrition in Perspective (HFA 4U) or any university level Nutrition course.Extra Information: 3 lecture hours (includes in-class activities)/ week.

column1: FOODNUTR 0012B - INTRO TO F&N: LIFE CYCLE NUTR
column2: Course Description: An introductory course about the basic aspects of Life Cycle Nutrition. Emphasis will be placed on how students can use credible resources to find information about nutrition recommendations and eating habits of Canadians of all ages and life stages, nutrition and disease prevention, nutrition and physical activity, safe food handling procedures, food biotechnology and global hunger. Antirequisite(s): Grade 12U Nutrition in Perspective (HFA 4U) or any university level Nutrition course.Extra Information: 3 lecture hours (includes in-class activities)/ week.

column1: FOODNUTR 4410A - GLOBAL POLICIES IN FOOD SAFETY
column2: Course Description: Food safety policy is examined at local, national, international, and global levels.
